Transmute Mud To Rock (W5 Tran): R270' Coverts 340 cubic feet of mud or quicksand to rock, trapping creatures within (save Reflex negates)
Transmute Rock To Mud (W5 Tran): R270' Converts 340 cubic feet of unworked rock to mud
Trap The Soul (W8 Conj): R65' Imprisons the target in a gem, either by saying the spell (save Will negates; -2 if the target's name is also uttered), or by tricking the target into taking a trigger object (no save)
True Seeing (W6 Divi): Allows touched to see through 120' darkness, illusion, and invisibility, note secret doors, and see the true forms of polymorphed items for 17 min
True Strike (W1 Divi): Gives self +20 on the next attack before the end of the next rd
Undeath To Death (W6 Necr): R270' Destroys 17d4 HD of undead with up to 8 HD in a 40' radius (save Will negates), working upward from those with the fewest HD
Unseen Servant (W1 Conj): R65' Creates an invisible servant with Strength 2 and a 15' Speed that can perform simple tasks for 17 hr
Vampiric Touch (W3 Necr): Melee touch attack inflicts 8d6 HP and gives self the same number of temporary HP for 1 hr
Veil (W6 Illu): R1080' Makes creatures in a 15' radius appear to be different creatures (save Will negates for targets; save Will upon interaction disbelieves for others) for concentration + 17 hr
Ventriloquism (W1 Illu): Allows speech to originate from a spot within 65' (save Will disbelieves) for 17 min
Vision (W7 Divi): Allows a successful caster level check to answer a question about a specified person, place, or object; the DC varies from 20 to 30 depending on the familiarity of the subject
Wail Of The Banshee (W9 Necr): R65' Slays 17 targets within 40' (save Fortitude negates)
Wall Of Fire (W4 Evoc): R270' Creates a 340'x20' wall or a 40'x20' ring that inflicts 2d4 HP fire to creatures within 10', 1d4 HP fire to creatures within 20', and 2d6+17 HP fire when passing through (or double these damages to undead) for concentration + 17 rd
Wall Of Force (W5 Evoc): R65' Creates an invisible, impassible, and immobile 170 square foot wall for 17 rd; the wall can be damaged only by Disintegrate, Mage's Disjunction, a rod of cancellation, or a sphere of annihilation
Wall Of Ice (W4 Evoc): R270' Creates a 170 square foot wall or a 20' radius hemisphere of 17"-thick ice for 17 min; each 10' section has 51 hit points, and passing through a broken section of the wall inflicts 1d6+17 HP cold
Wall Of Iron (W6 Conj): R270' Creates a 85 square foot, 4"-thick permanent iron wall (the area can be doubled by halving the thickness); if unanchored, the wall falls (a successful DC 40 Strength check pushes it to fall in the desired direction), inflicting 10d6 HP on Large and smaller creatures (save Reflex negates)
Wall Of Stone (W5 Conj): R270' Creates a 85 square foot, 4"-thick permanent stone wall (the area can be doubled by halving the thickness); each 5' section has 60 hit points and hardness 8
Water Breathing (W3 Tran): Allows touched creatures to breathe underwater for a total of 34 hrs
Waves Of Exhaustion (W7 Necr): 60' cone inflicts exhausted
Waves Of Fatigue (W5 Necr): 30' cone inflicts fatigued
Web (W2 Conj): R270' Anchored web strands in a 20' radius immobilize creatures (save Reflex negates, and a DC 20 Strength or DC 25 Escape Artist breaks free) for 170 min; movement through the web requires a Strength or Escape Artist check each rd, allowing 5' of movement for each 5 points that the check exceeds 10; burning clears the web, inflicting 2d4 HP fire on those within
Weird (W9 Illu): R270' Fears of targets in a 15' radius create creatures (save Will negates) whose touch kills its target (save Fortitude inflicts 3d6 HP, -1d4 Strength, and stunned for 1 rd)
Whispering Wind (W2 Tran): R17 miles Allows sending a whispered 25-word message or sound to a familiar 10' area
Wind Wall (W3 Evoc): R270' Creates a 170'x85'x2' curtain of air that scatters objects, bars gasses and Small or smaller flying creatures, and deflects arrows and bolts for 17 rd
Wish (W9 Univ): Alters reality, with few limits; costs at least 5,000 XP to cast
Magic Notes:
School Specialization (Evocation): +1 Evocation spell slot in each spell level
Arcane Spell Failure: 15%
Brew Potion: Can create potions for known, targeted spells of up to 3rd level
Craft Rod: Can create magic rods
Craft Staff: Can create magic staves
Enlarge Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to double its range
School Opposition (Abjuration): Cannot learn or cast Abjuration spells
School Opposition (Conjuration): Cannot learn or cast Conjuration spells
Scribe Scroll: Can create scrolls for known spells
Still Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without somatic components
Companions
Familiar: Tiny Viper "Ofeme"
Str: 4 (-3) Dex: 17 (+3) Con: 11 (+0) Int: 14 (+2) Wis: 12 (+1) Cha: 2 (-4) Size: T Speed: 15
HD/HP: 17/31 Init: +3 AC: 26 Attack: +16 1 Fort/Ref/Will: +5/+8/+11 SR: 22
Familiar Features: Companion Alertness; Companion Evasion; Companion Improved Evasion; Companion Spell Resistance; Deliver Touch Spells; Empathic Link; Scry On Familiar; Share Spells; Speak With Animals Of Its Kind; Speak With Master
Companion Notes:
Companion Improved Evasion: Has increased Companion Evasion effects
Companion Spell Resistance: Has SR 22
Companion Evasion: Successful Reflex saves by companion yield no damage instead of half, and failed Reflex saves yield half damage
Deliver Touch Spells: Can use companion to deliver touch spells if in contact when the spell is cast
Empathic Link: Can communicate emotions with companion up to 1 mile
Scry On Familiar: Can view companion once per day
Share Spells: Can cast a personal spell on an adjacent companion and have a targeted spell cast on self also affect a companion while it is within 5'
Speak With Animals Of Its Kind: Companion can communicate with similar creatures
Speak With Master: Can talk with companion in a shared, secret language
Summon Familiar: Can bond with a magical creature with expanded abilities; death of the creature inflicts a loss of 3400 experience points (save Fortitude DC 15 half), and a new familiar cannot be summoned for a year and a day
